ind. A prefix used with the root धा; see श्रद्धा.
P. (श्रथति, श्रथ्नाति) To hurt, injure, kill. --

P., 10 U. (श्रथति, श्राथयति-ते) 
__1 To hurt, kill. 
__2 To untie, loosen, liberate, release. --

U. (श्रथयति-ते) 
__1 To make efforts, be occupied or busy. 
__2 To be weak or infirm. 
__3 To be glad.

__1 Killing, destruction.

a. Having faith, trustful, believing; अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति [[

€3U. 
__1 To confide, believe, put faith in (with acc. of thing); कः श्रद्धास्यति भूतार्थम् [[

__1 Trust, faith, belief, confidence. 
__2 Belief in divine revelation, religious faith; श्रद्धा वित्तं विधिश्चेति त्रितयं तत्समागतम् [[Ś. 7. 29]]; [[

]]; 7. 21; 17. 3.

__6 Strong or vehement desire; तथापि वैचित्र्यरहस्यलुब्धाः श्रद्धां विधास्यन्ति सचेतसोऽत्र [[

.]]

-Comp. 
-जाड्यम् blind faith.

a. [श्रद्धा हेतुत्वेनास्त्यस्य अण्] Faithful, believing. 
-द्धम् 
__1 A funeral rite or ceremony performed in honour of the departed spirits of dead relatives; श्रद्धया दीयते यस्मात्तस्माच्छ्राद्धं निगद्यते; it is of three kinds:- नित्य, नैमित्तिक, and काम्य; यः संगतानि कुरुते मोहाच्छ्राद्धेन मानवः [[

.]] 
__2 An obsequial oblation, a gift or offering at a Śrāddha; बिहाय शोकं धर्मात्मा ददौ श्राद्धमनुत्तमम् [[

]]; सर्वं श्रद्धया दत्तं श्राद्धम् [[Pratimā 5.]] 
-Comp. 
-कर्मन् n., 
-क्रिया a funeral ceremony. 
-कृत् m. the performer of a funeral rite. 
-दः the offerer of a Śrāddha or funeral oblation. 
-दिनः, -नम् the anniversary of the death of a relative in whose honour a Śrāddha is performed. 
-देवः, -देवता 
__1 a deity presiding over funeral rites. 
__2 an epithet of Yama. 
__3 a Viśvadeva q. v. 
__4 a Pitṛ or progenitor. 
-भुज् a. eating food prepared at a श्राद्ध; श्राद्धभुग्वृषलीतल्पं तदहर्योऽधिगच्छति [[

.]] 
-भुज्, -भोक्तृ m. a deceased ancestor. 
-मित्रः making friends through a श्राद्ध; cf. श्राद्धम् (1) above; स स्वर्गाच्छ्यवते लोकाच्छ्राद्धमित्रो द्विजाधमः [[

a. [श्रद्धा-आलुच्] 
__1 Believing, full of faith, 
__2 Desirous, longing or wishing for (anything); अकालकुसुमसमुद्गमश्रद्धालुना भर्त्रा [[

.]] 
-लुः f. A pregnant woman longing for anything.
a. Fit for श्राद्ध; अश्राद्धेयानि धान्यानि कोद्रबाः पुलकास्तथा [[

Ā. (श्रन्थते) 
__1 To be weak. 
__2 To be loose or relaxed. 
__3 To loosen, relax. --

P. (श्रथ्नाति) 
__1 To loosen, liberate, release. 
__2 To delight repeatedly. --
P. To bind together, to compose; [[L. D. B.]]

__1 Loosening, liberating. 
__2 Looseness. 
__3 Binding, tying together. 
__4 N. of Viṣṇu.

__1 Loosing, untying. 
__2 Hurting, killing, destroying. 
__3 Tying, binding. 
__4 Composing (a book).

p. p. 
__1 Loosed, liberated, let loose. 
__2 Connected; strung or bound together. 
__3 Hurt, injured. 
__4 Overcome, overpowered. 
__5 Delighted.

श्रपणम्,
 
-णा Causing to boil, boiling, seething. 
-णः Cooking fire (आहवनीय or गार्हपत्य).

p. p. 
__1 Boiled or caused to be boiled. 
__2 Seethed. 
-तम् Boiled meat &c. 
-ता Rice-gruel.

€4P. (श्राम्यति, श्रान्त) 
__1 To exert oneself, take pains, toil, labour. 
__2 To perform austerities, mortify the body (by acts of penance); कियच्चिरं श्राम्यसि गौरि [[

.]] 
__3 To be wearied or fatigued, be exhausted; रतिश्रान्ता शेते रजनिरमणी गाढमुरसि [[K.

.]] 
__4 To be afflicted or distressed; यो वृन्दानि त्वरयति पथि श्राम्यतां प्रोषितानाम् [[

.]] -Caus. (श्र-श्रामयति-ते) To cause to be fatigued &c. 
__2 To overcome, conquer, subdue.

[श्रम्-घञ् न वृद्धिः] 
__1 Toil, labour, exertion, effort; अलं महीपाल तव श्रमेण [[
]]; जानाति हि पुनः सम्यक् कविरेव कवेः श्रमम् [[Subhāṣ.]]; [[

.]] 
__2 Weariness, fatigue, exhaustion; विनयन्ते स्म तद्योधा मधुभिर्विजयश्रमम् [[

.]] 
__4 Penance, austerity, mortification of the body; दिवं यदि प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः [[

.]] 
___(b) Especially military exercise, drill. 
__6 Hard study. 
__7 = आश्रम q. v.; तदा स पर्याववृते श्रमाय [[

.]]

.]] [Page1574-1]

-विनोदः the act of dispelling fatigue. 
-साध्य a. to be accomplished by dint of labour. 
-स्थानम् a drill-ground, gymnasium &c.

श्रयणम् [श्रि-घञ् ल्युट् वा] Refuge, shelter, protection, asylum; (see आश्रय).

[शृणोत्यनेन श्रु-अप्]

.]] 
__3 The hypotenuse of a triangle. 
__4 Flowing, oozing (for स्रव). 5 Fame, glory.

__2 A drop flow, stream; विपुलौ स्नपयन्ती सा स्तनौ नेत्रजलस्रवैः [[Rām.]] 
__3 A fountain, spring. 
__4 Urine.

श्रवणः,
 
-णम् [शृणोत्यनेन श्रु-क्रणे ल्युट्]

.]]

__1 The act of hearing; श्रवणसुभगम् [[

.]] 
__2 Study. 
__3 Fame, glory. 
__4 That which is heard or revealed, the Veda;

‘because of such a Vedic text’. 
__5 Wealth. 
__6 Flowing, oozing. 
__7 (In phil.) The determining by means of the six signs the true doctrine of the Vedānta. 
-Comp. 
-अधिकारिन् m. a speaker, addresser. 
-इन्द्रियम् the sense of hearing, the ear. 
-उत्पलम् a lotus fastened in the ear. 
-उदरम् the hollow of the outer ear. 
-कातरता anxiety for hearing. 
-गोचर a. within the range of hearing. 
(-रः) ear-shot; as in श्रवणगोचरे तिष्ठ ‘be within earshot’.

.]]

-प्राघुणिकः coming to any one's ear.
